title: Arrow rain
description: Alert! The weather forecast says: arrows. Lots of arrows. Keep moving!
body: In this datapack every tick (every 50 milliseconds) 1 arrow spawns 5 blocks over every players head. The arrows get deleted after 5 seconds to reduce lag. You cannot pick up the arrows. I don´t really plan updating this project unless I find a glitch to patch. In case you want to use it for a Modpack you are allowed to do that.
